title: Research feeds
context: Original titles and summaries collected from {count} administrator-approved sources. Not reviewed.
empty: No items match. Change the category, field or search words.
emptyAll: Approved sources have no collected items yet. Once an administrator approves sources, the hub server collects them on a schedule.
failed: Could not read the research feeds.
openOriginal: Opens the original in a new tab

import.note: Fills {repo} into the GitHub import of Settings → Skills. Nothing is installed until you preview it and agree.
import.noProjects: There is no project to import into. Create a project first.

offline.title: Log in to the institute GAID hub to see research feeds
offline.body: The institute hub server collects the sources an administrator approved. Log in under Settings → Services → Institute GAID hub.

admin.intro: The hub server reads approved sources only, every {hours} hours. It stores the original title, the feed summary and the link.
admin.fetching: Reading the sources. This can take a few minutes.
admin.failed: Could not read or change the source list.

add.title: Add a source
add.name: Source name
add.queries: Search queries (one per line, up to 5)
add.match: Words to keep (comma-separated; empty keeps all)
